headline: Profit growth outpaces revenue as margins expand
summary_short: AppLovin's Q1 FY2026 revenue of $1,842.4M rose 11.1% q/q and 59.0% y/y, with net income of $1,205.6M up 109.2% y/y.
summary_long: Revenue of $1,842.4M grew 11.1% q/q and 59.0% y/y. EBITDA margin expanded to about 82.3% of revenue, up from roughly 80.7% last quarter and 80.0% a year ago. Net income of $1,205.6M rose 9.4% q/q and 109.2% y/y, with diluted EPS of $3.56 up 9.9% q/q and 113.2% y/y. Total cash rose 10.9% q/q and 400.7% y/y to $2,758.7M.
